body_1: Babycakes was born from a simple belief: that food baked with love tastes different. We sit comfortably in the Affordable Luxury niche — more premium than street bakeries, more personal than hotel patisseries.
headline: Feel good food, baked with love.
body_2: The Soft Chocolate Baby Tray — built on a 1999 family recipe — remains our primary product. Priced from ฿210 to encourage everyday gifting and impulse buying.
